verdict.rationale: Omarchy documents automatic system snapshots on updates and a manual `omarchy-snapshot create` command. That is whole-system rollback, an adjacent feature rather than a way to version, review, or roll back automations specifically. Lazygit is a bundled general-purpose git client, which would make versioning a user-side workaround. Nothing in the evidence describes an automation object with history, diff/review, or targeted rollback.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
